headline: Colombia's fiscal rescue bill reaches 100-day mark as tax reform debate continues
summary: The Colombian government's 'Ley de Rescate' tax package reached its 100-day milestone as ministers push to balance public accounts while debating tax contributions from workers and businesses.
why: Fiscal reform legislation in Colombia is aimed at meeting debt spending rules and maintaining international credit ratings.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Progress on tax reform shapes national deficit reduction and sovereign fiscal policy.
